subject: general
question:
Study the following bar graph and answer the question that follows.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d260d36b27e7efc3d6adb60eb224a86d1620a2dfd64e0c0df99664243982b88f.png] 

What is the approximate difference in the number of accounts for March 2010 and March 2011 as a percentage of the total number of accounts represented in the graph?
solution:
Total number of accounts = 73.45 + 104.76 + 138.50 + 182.06

⇒ 498.77

Difference of number of accounts in 2010 and 2011 = 104.76 - 73.45

⇒ 31.31

Required percentage = (31.31/498.77) × 100

⇒ 6.27% or 6%

**∴ The approximate difference in the number of accounts for March 2010 and March 2011 as a 6% of the total number of accounts represented in the graph.**
